artifactPurpose: Consolidated frontend source for https://app.nabatable.com/settings/restaurant/tables, generated for analysis.

included: Tables settings route and TableInventoryClient feature module
Shared restaurant settings layout, shell, subnav, and reachable traced frontend dependencies
Narrow route-boundary files for app-host URL rewriting and href normalization
excluded: tests, task folders, scripts, migrations, build output, node_modules, env files, and secrets
scope.note: tables route bundle. Sibling routes omitted on purpose. Backend-only imports are listed in skippedLocalDependencies.
